name: Adzviser
description:
Connect marketing, sales, and CRM data to Claude

Browse, analyze, and summarize live reporting data directly from Claude. Adzviser helps marketing teams pull data from platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and more — so they can audit performance, compare channels, and get insights without exporting CSVs or switching tools.

Popular data sources customers connect include: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, YouTube Analytics, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Snapchat Ads, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Google Merchant Center, Apple Ads, DV360, Reddit Ads, WooCommerce, X (Twitter) Ads and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser lists 58 MCP tools, including list_countries_fb_ad_library, list_countries_google_ads_transparency, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_activecampaign, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_adobe_analytics, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_adroll, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_amazon_ads, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_amazon_seller, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_apple_ads, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bigcommerce, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bing_ads, list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bing_webmaster, and list_metrics_and_breakdowns_call_tracking_metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Adzviser requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser is developed by Adzviser. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
